items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: I've been working with... Alphonse Fish, who was playing in the band

ctx.x: Okay. And you've been working with a Gibson band, I guess, for the last... How long have you been with a Gibson band?

Well, I've been working with... I don't know how long it's been, but I know after this fella died... Yeah. ...Alphonse Fish, who was playing in the band... Yeah. ...and he took the band over after he died. Oh, no. Jimmy Jackson. Oh, yeah. He's living on the south, you know.
He didn't play any instrument, did he, Jackson? He just managed the band. He used to play, but he stopped him. Yeah, yeah, just managed the band. Yeah.
